about.metaDescription: Learn how the Hopeland Global Checkers World Championship runs, from regional qualifiers to the live-streamed world final.
about.subtitle: Hopeland Global Checkers brings together players from over 120 countries in a transparent, fairly-judged path from local qualifier to world champion.
about.pillarGlobalText: Regional qualifiers run across five continents and feed directly into the World Championship bracket.
about.pillarFairText: An independent referee panel and digital move-review system protect every result, every round.
about.pillarStakesText: A growing prize pool is distributed across finalists in the Open, Masters, and Junior divisions.
about.pillarOpenText: From first-time club players to federation-rated masters, there is a division built for every skill level.
about.openDivisionText: Open to all players. Regional qualifiers determine seeding for the World Championship bracket.
about.mastersDivisionText: Reserved for federation-rated players competing for the highest level of recognition.
about.juniorDivisionText: For competitors under 16, with dedicated qualifiers and a standalone Junior world title.
